stem: What was the primary reason for U.S. involvement in East Asia during the early 1950s?

options.label: F
options.text: North Korean attempts to unify the peninsula challenged the U.S. policy of containment.

options.label: G
options.text: Communities in Korea needed humanitarian aid due to a famine.

options.label: H
options.text: International groups needed help investigating North Korean officials charged with corruption.

options.label: J
options.text: Democratic reformers sought help from the U.S. military to overthrow dictatorial regimes in Korea.
